{{External|rs|rsc=Magic Logs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Magic logs |image = [[File:Magic logs.png]] |release = [[25 March]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (25 March 2002) |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = No |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Drop |examine = Logs cut from a magic tree. |value = 320 |weight = 2.000 |exchange = Yes |id = 1513 }} [[File:Magic logs detail.png|left|130px]] '''Magic logs''' are logs that can be acquired using the [[Woodcutting]] [[skill]] from [[magic tree]]s. Cutting magic trees requires a Woodcutting level of 75 or higher and yields 250 Woodcutting [[experience]] per log cut. Due to the slow speed at which magic trees are cut at this level, it is advised that players wait until they have a Woodcutting level of at least 85 before chopping magic trees. Players can expect to gain up to 130 magic logs per hour using a [[dragon axe]]. Magic logs can be fletched into [[Magic shortbow (u)|unstrung magic shortbows]] with a [[Fletching]] level of 80, granting 83.3 Fletching experience, or into [[Magic longbow (u)|unstrung magic longbows]] with a Fletching level of 85, granting 91.5 Fletching experience. Magic logs can also be burnt with a [[Firemaking]] level of 75, granting 303.8 Firemaking experience. Magic logs are needed for three quests: twelve for [[Desert Treasure I]], one for [[Mourning's End Part I]], and three for unlocking the [[Gnome Stronghold]] [[balloon route]] (requirement for [[Monkey Madness II]]), requiring sixteen magic logs in total. [[Ultimate Ironmen]] can permanently store magic logs with the [[Friendly Forester]] log storage or balloon transport [[log storage]]. 6 magic logs can be used to light an [[Abyssal lantern (magic logs)|Abyssal lantern]], requiring 75 Firemaking. ==Skilling info== {{Woodcutting info |name = Magic Tree |level = 75 |xp = 250 |tree = [[Magic tree]] |tool = [[Axe]] |time = 119.4 seconds }} {{Firemaking info |version1 = Tinderbox |version2 = Bow |version3 = Barbarian pyre |version4 = Bonfire |skill2name = Crafting |name = Magic logs |skill1lvl1 = 75 |skill1lvl2 = 95 |pyrelevel = 85 |craftxp = 75.9 |skill1lvl3 = 85 |skill2lvl3 = 85 |skill1lvl4 = 75 |skill1exp1 = 303.8 |skill1exp2 = 303.8 |skill1exp3 = 303.8 |skill1exp4 = 303.8 |facility1 = N/A |facility2 = N/A |facility3 = [[Funeral pyre (Barbarian)|Barbarian funeral pyre]] |facility4 = [[Fire]] or [[Forester's Campfire]] |tool1 = [[Tinderbox]] |tool2 = [[Bow]] |tool3 = [[Tinderbox]] or [[bow]], and an [[axe]] |tool4 = N/A |type = logs }} ==Money making== {{Mmgsection|Cutting magic logs|Making magic pyre logs}} ==Obtaining magic logs== Aside from chopping [[magic tree]]s, there are other ways to obtain magic logs, which is particularly useful for [[ironmen]] accounts. They are available from the [[Reward Cart]] from the [[Wintertodt]] and [[Hunters' loot sack]] from [[Hunters' Rumours]]. Both sources require minimum level 50 Woodcutting to obtain Magic logs as a reward, and rarity scales with Woodcutting level. They can also be obtained from [[Brimstone chest]] (1/30 chance) by completing Slayer tasks for [[Konar quo Maten]] if you have 75 combat and get a [[Brimstone key]], and [[Larran's big chest]] (1/30 chance) if you are doing [[Krystilia|Wilderness Slayer]] and obtain a [[Larran's key]]. Magic logs can also be obtained from taking [[Barbarian Assault/Gambles#High Gambles|High Gambles]] with points from the [[Barbarian Assault/Gambles#High Gambles|Barbarian Assault]] minigame. Towards the end of the [[Legends' Quest]], it is possible to obtain them by allowing [[yommi tree|Yommi sapling]]s to die and chopping them down, which will yield magic logs about 27% of the time. '''This cannot be done once the quest is complete.''' This is a slow and tedious process (~2–4 hours to get the 16 needed), but may be preferable to other options. Approximately 200 seeds are required for 16 magic logs to complete Desert Treasure I, Mourning's End Part 1 and the Gnome Stronghold Balloon Route. In addition, there are several NPCs from whom players can receive magic logs, found in the list below. ==Products== {{Uses material list|Magic logs}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Magic logs}} ==Treasure Trails== *{{SherlockChallenge|Burning a magic log|master}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 17 July 2007 |update = Game Improvements (July 2007) |change = The item was graphically updated to distinguish it from [[Willow logs]]. }} {{Subject changes |date = 2 May 2006 |update = Return of the Wise Old Man! |change = The item's examine was changed from "''Logs made from magical wood.''" to "''Logs cut from a magic tree.''" }} {{Subject changes |date = 11 July 2005 |update = Farming |change = The item was graphically updated with the release of [[Farming]]. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Magic logs detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Magic logs detail (historical v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Magic logs detail (historical v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Magic logs detail animated.gif|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Magic logs (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Magic logs (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Magic logs (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Magic logs animated.gif|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
